summary_en: Yoshicon established a share buyback program of up to 200,000 shares (2.9% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of ¥500 million through March 31, 2027, via market purchases including ToSTNeT-3.
title_en: Notice Regarding Market Purchases of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief:
On April 30, 2026, Yoshicon's board of directors authorized a treasury share acquisition program under Article 165 of the Companies Act. The program permits the company to repurchase up to 200,000 ordinary shares (representing 2.9 percent of issued shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum aggregate consideration of ¥500 million through March 31, 2027. The acquisitions will be executed via market purchases, including trades on the Tokyo Stock Exchange using the ToSTNeT-3 off-floor trading mechanism.

As of October 31, 2026, the company had completed purchases of 134,500 shares for an aggregate amount of ¥293,042,800, representing approximately 67 percent consumption of the authorized share count and 59 percent of the authorized expenditure limit. The buyback is conducted in accordance with the Companies Act provisions on treasury share acquisition as specified in the company's articles of incorporation.
